_comment: Example of relaxing the defaults for a writer whose profile records deliberate dash use: the hard dash ban comes off and the density cap catches overuse instead. Loosen a rule only when your voice profile shows the habit is really yours (evidence, not aspiration), and record the override in Voice_Profile.md so the judgment layer agrees with the linter. The config is deep-merged onto the defaults, so unlisted top-level fields and unlisted nested keys inherit: setting watch_words.quietly below leaves the default watch_words.live untouched. To amend a shipped list without restating it, use add_banned_phrases / remove_banned_phrases and the like.
